> 天地雖大，其化均也；萬物雖多，其治一也。

Heaven and earth are vast, and their transformation is even. The ten thousand things are many, and their order is one.

The chapter runs long and is easy to skim. It has one word in it that is worth the whole afternoon.

## 刳心: hollow it out with a blade

刳: 刀 with 夸 as phonetic — to cut open and scoop out.

君子不可以不刳心 — a gentleman cannot do without hollowing his heart. Not removing it. Scooping out the set already installed in it, so that there is room.

This is the same operation as 心齋 in 人間世, and the word is harder. 齋 says: still it. 刳 says: cut it open. One names the state, the other names the action that gets you there.

## 機心: the heart that sees a machine

機: the trigger mechanism on a crossbow — the release, the catch, the part that makes the arrow go.

機心 is not "cleverness," and it is not greed. The book's definition is sharper: it is the heart that takes the world as an apparatus with levers — something you can pull, tune, and get output from.

That is why the charge is not moral. It is a worldview being named: once the world is a machine, everything in it becomes an input, including people, including you.

## 純白不備: read the four characters together

純: unmixed, unalloyed. 白: undyed, the plain color. 備: complete, intact.

純白不備 is not "you are missing a virtue." It is: the original is no longer whole. The word 備 matters — the loss is not of a piece, it is of wholeness.

## 標枝 and 野鹿

標枝: the tip of a branch, high up, exerting nothing downward. 野鹿: the deer in the open, unherded.

Set side by side they describe those above and those below, and both are characterized the same way: neither is being driven. One is simply there; the other simply moves.

## 趣舍滑心

趣: to take, to lean toward. 舍: to set aside. 滑: 水 with 骨 as phonetic — slippery; extended, to muddle, to make something lose its footing.

Taking and discarding, liking and disliking, keep moving; the heart cannot stand firmly, and the nature drifts outward.

Note that 滑 is not "corruption." It is loss of footing under continuous small movements. Nothing dramatic happened. That is the point.

## 混冥

混: merged. 冥: dark, undivided. 萬物復情，此之謂混冥 — the ten thousand things return to their actual state, and that is called 混冥.

They have not disappeared. They have stopped presenting themselves as distinctions.

## The test

Name one system you are currently optimizing — a team, a household, a body, a habit. Then ask the 機 question: in your hands, is it a thing with a nature, or a machine with levers? The second answer is not cruel; it is what makes the first answer impossible.
